Notices for code inside react-dom.production.min.js

react-dom.production.min.js (react-dom 18.3.1) has two other pieces compiled into it:

  scheduler 0.23.2 (MIT), Copyright (c) Facebook, Inc. and its affiliates. Same
  licence text as the LICENSE file in this folder.

  A custom build of Modernizr 3.0.0pre (MIT). Its one-line notice,
  "Modernizr 3.0.0pre (Custom Build) | MIT", is kept at the top of the bundle's body,
  as React ships it. The modernizr npm tarball carries no licence text beyond that
  line, so none is reproduced here.
